Did you know (speaking of the song of the season) that it's true that "lake superior never gives up her dead"? The bacteria that cause corpses to bloat (and, thus, float) can't grow in the water, because it's so cold. Bodies do decompose, but it takes a couple years.

Fun fact for anyone near the lake: The bodies in Lake Superior are kept mostly preserved from how cold it is, and they sink from the cold. If the temperature of the water rose too much (2 degrees I think), Lake Superior would start returning her collection to the surface. Enjoy :)
